About me

Hello, I'm Mae. Think of me as your business's secret weapon.

For 2.5 years I was the full-time remote engine behind a U.S. real estate brokerage. I ran their social media across four platforms, designed their marketing, edited their videos, built their custom tracking systems, handled billing and payroll support, and kept their calendar and inbox under control.

I studied Nursing, and it shows in how I work: I'm precise with details, careful with records, calm when things get busy, and I care about the people I support. I pair that with a creative eye and a love for systems that make work run itself.

I don't wait to be told what's next. I spot what needs doing and get it done.

What I changed

01
A real posting plan

I replaced random, now-and-then posts with a planned content calendar, so every post had a purpose and the page always had something ready to go out.

02
Short-form video

I planned, shot and edited listing walkthroughs and Shorts built to stop the scroll. The biggest spike of the quarter came the day after one went live.

03
A consistent schedule

I posted on a steady schedule, so the audience knew when to expect new content and the algorithm kept showing the page to new people.
